title: Pending test-request status read walks an over-limit pending JSON value's overflow pages under the shared mailbox connection mutex
outcome: Pending test-request status read walks an over-limit pending JSON value's overflow pages under the shared mailbox connection mutex
acceptance: A live or fixture measurement shows whether the status read's overflow-page traversal for an over-limit pending value causes a user-visible delay on the shared mailbox connection; the measurement is recorded on this item.

If it does, the status read for such a row no longer traverses the over-limit value's overflow pages, and existing rows and the wire format are unchanged; if it does not, the item is closed with that measurement as its evidence.
